name: url-shortener
description: A small REST service from written requirements, judged by 25 hidden HTTP acceptance checks (validation, status codes, redirects, click counts, persistence across restart, CR/LF in URLs).

input.request: A URL shortener HTTP API. POST /links with JSON {url, slug?} creates a short link: url must be an absolute http or https URL (max 2048 chars); slug is optional, 3-32 chars of [a-z0-9-], must be unique (409 if taken); without a slug generate a random 6-char one. GET /:slug redirects with 302 to the url and counts the click. GET /links/:slug returns {slug, url, clicks, createdAt}. GET /links lists all links, newest first. DELETE /links/:slug removes it (204). Unknown slugs give 404 with a JSON error. Links survive a restart. Reject request bodies over 10 KB with 413 and malformed JSON with 400. The port comes from PORT and the data file path from DATA_FILE.
input.stack: Node.js 22, no external dependencies (node:http, node:test), persistence in a JSON file written atomically. npm start runs the server.
